title: Figure 27: Photomicrograph of titanium metal integrated with living bone
description: Color photomicrograph of pink-stained bone tissue with a scalloped interface against a black region representing titanium. Caption: "Figure 27. Photomicrograph of Titanium Metal (Appears Black in This Photo) in an Intimate Integration With Living Bone. The intersection of the two materials shows a thin barrier layer and then healthy tissue very close to the metal." The text discusses surface treatments and hydroxyapatite coatings for bone integration.
